name: blog-post
title: Blog post
description: Article layout with a title, author, dates, body content, and related posts.
usage: Blog posts and guides. Pass the dot field (HeroDotField) as `background`, the article as BlogProse children or `html`, and code samples as BlogCodeBlock inside it (light, with a "copy" pill, as the site's posts draw them). Follow the post with RelatedArticles (three BlogCards, white and blue in turn, in a ruled section; RelatedPosts and RelatedPostCard are deprecated), then ClosingCta.
avoid: The dark CodeWindow for samples inside an article (use BlogCodeBlock)
Line numbers in an article's code
A second column beside the article
